fact: Employers must ensure the health, safety and welfare of their employees

fact: Extends a similar duty to people who are not employees

quote: Section 8 goes further: no one may intentionally or recklessly interfere with or misuse anything provided in the interests of health and safety.

fact: Directors and managers can be personally prosecuted

fact: HSE sets out five steps for risk assessment

fact: Includes any injury requiring more than 24 hours in hospital
quote: and any injury requiring more than 24 hours in hospital

fact: Report without delay, with the written report following within 10 days
quote: it must be reported to HSE without delay, with the written report following within 10 days

fact: Unable to do normal duties for more than 7 consecutive days: report within 15 days of the accident

fact: Specified injuries and dangerous occurrences: without delay; over-7-day injuries: within 15 days
quote: Specified injuries and dangerous occurrences: report without delay. Over-7-day injuries: report within 15 days.

fact: Three elements: heat, fuel and oxygen; removing one is enough

fact: Only safe on electrical fires up to 1000V, not above

fact: May be present in any building built or refurbished before 2000

quote: Three types were historically used — chrysotile (white), amosite (brown), and crocidolite (blue)

fact: WEL 0.1 mg/m³ as an 8-hour time-weighted average
quote: Its workplace exposure limit is 0.1 mg/m³ as an 8-hour time-weighted average.

fact: 80 dB(A): assess risk; provide hearing protection if requested
quote: At the lower exposure action value of 80 dB(A), the employer must assess the risk and provide hearing protection if a worker requests it.

fact: 85 dB(A): hearing protection mandatory; hearing protection zone marked
quote: At the upper exposure action value of 85 dB(A), hearing protection becomes mandatory and the area must be marked as a hearing protection zone.

fact: 87 dB(A): must never be exceeded, even taking hearing protection into account
quote: The exposure limit value of 87 dB(A) must never be exceeded, even taking into account any hearing protection being worn

fact: EAV 2.5 m/s² A(8); ELV 5.0 m/s² A(8)

fact: Five categories (toilets, washing, water, rest, changing), scaled to the site

quote: CDM 2015 sets out, in Schedule 2, the welfare facilities every construction site must provide

fact: Three levels, in order: avoid, prevent, minimise
quote: The hierarchy is strict and sequential — avoid, then prevent, then minimise.

fact: Base 1 unit out for every 4 units of working height — roughly 75 degrees

quote: with the gap to any intermediate rail no more than 470 millimetres

fact: A cubic metre of soil can weigh well over 1.5 tonnes
